messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "use non-hormone birth control method to prevent pregnancy"
set: ["use non-hormone birth control method to prevent pregnancy", "use effective birth control to avoid pregnancy", "to prevent dizziness", "ask your doctor about using a non-hormonal birth control", "this does not usually prevent their use", "prevent dehydration", "prevent choking", "use extra care to prevent bleeding while shaving or brushing teeth", "use 2 inhalations 15 to 30 minutes before you exercise to prevent exercise-induced bronchospasm", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to prevent nausea and vomiting", "during pregnancy", "follow special diet to help prevent kidney stones", "avoid use during second or third trimester of pregnancy", "take tablets after meals to help prevent stomach upset", "do not use to prevent hives from known causes such as foods, insect stings, or medicines", "store in safe place to prevent stealing or abuse"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
